crossRefs.note: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord!
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

translations.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
translations.asv: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,
